Used to drive a terrestrial land vehicle. Once gaining a rank after Rank 0 in drive, choose to specialize in one of the following:

  • Civilian: Used for typical and common vehicles available to the general population, such as cars, motorcycles, etc.
  • Grav: Used for high-tech vehicles that float above the ground and have different handling properties from traction-based land vehicles.
  • Industrial: Used for industrial vehicles that require specific training for license.
  • Marine: Used for any water-based craft.
  • Military: Used for military-grade vehicles that the general civilian wouldn't have access to.
  • Misc: Used for dirt-drillers, walking mecha, or any other non-traditional vehicle forms, as determined by the referee.

Specialized Skill: when this Skill is acquired at Rank 0, the rank applies to any of the related specialty Skills. Once the Skill is acquired again, the character must choose a specialized version of that Skill to excel in.

You have received training in using weapons and/or your fists offensively. Once you gain a rank past zero, you must select one of the following specializations:

  • Blade: Used to wield swords, axes, and other bladed melee weapons.
  • Hand-to-Hand: Used for boxing, martial arts, grappling, and related actions.
  • Bludgeon: Used for bludgeoning weapons and polearms without blades.

Used for flying craft, both in an atmosphere and in a vacuum. Once gaining a rank after Rank 0 in Pilot, choose to specialize in one of the following:

  • Starship: Used for controlling any spacecraft in the vacuum of space, along with entry and exit of planetary atmospheres.
  • Aircraft: Used for piloting any non-starcraft vehicles capable of flight within an atmosphere.

Specialized Skill: when this Skill is acquired at Rank 0, the rank applies to any of the related specialty Skills. Once the Skill is acquired again, the character must choose a specialized version of that Skill to excel in.

When acquired, choose the professional focus of the PC to represent their ability to understand, navigate, or execute the responsibilities or tasks associated with that profession. For example, Scientist, where the Profession Skill is used to access and use laboratories, or Musician, using Profession to compose and perform music for an audience. This Skill is intentionally open-ended to allow players to have creative applications of this Skill, but cannot substitute for established Skills if other players have ranks in those. The referee has final say if a Profession rank allows the character to perform the profession in any given situation.

Untrained in a Skill: performing a task that requires a Skill in which the character has no rank incurs a -3DM.

Used for wielding projectile weapons such as handguns, rifles, energy guns, crossbows, etc. Once Rank 0 has been achieved in this Skill, any additional Skill ranks are applied to one of the following:

  • Short: Used for handguns such as pistols and revolvers.
  • Stock: Used for guns that require two hands to use, such as rifles, carbines, or SMGs.
  • Energy: Used for high tech-level weapons that use energy instead of ballistics.
  • Archaic: Used for low tech-level weapons such as bows, crossbows, slings, throwing weapons, etc.

Example: If a character gets Rank 0 in basic training, then learns Ranged Combat (short), they know Ranged Combat 0 and Ranged Combat (Short) 1. If the character attempts to use any ranged weapon that isn’t short, they only apply the Rank 0 to the Skill roll.

Used in combat to gain a battlefield advantage. When using Tactics in combat, the spacer directing the tactics can apply the rank as a +1DM per rank to any other NPC or characters for the battle. General Tactics is acquired at Rank 0 but advancing Tactics requires the character to select a specialization:

  • Starship: Used for knowledge and execution of strategies using naval starships in space combat.
  • Vehicle: Typically used by army-trained individuals for the proper application of tactical advantages and disadvantages of vehicular combat in battle.
  • Squad: Used for small-unit combat tactics applied to on-foot operations. Common training for army and marines.
  • Zero-G: Used while engaged in zero-G melee or ranged combat. Rank 0 means no penalty to attacks in zero-G, while any additional ranks are applied to any combat action while in zero-G in place of Vaccsuit. This is a common skill set for marine officers to learn.
